candidates.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: one square vocabulary illustration. Exact English sense: full (n.), Chinese meaning 全部. Scene: A complete set being taken together: a shallow divided wooden tray with six clearly shaped empty recesses and one person lifting out all six matching colorful wooden blocks together in an open fabric sling directly above the tray. Every recess is empty and every block is gathered, none left behind or outside the collection. Emphasize the entire quantity as a whole, all of it, not a container filled to capacity. The six blocks are the dominant subject; hands and tray support the totality relationship. Style: hand-painted gouache with subtle colored pencil texture, warm off-white paper, muted natural green blue coral palette.
